authored_from: graph/observed/funnel-policy.v1.json 1.0.0-rc1 NORMATIVE TEXT (candidates, subtraction_rules incl. every detection block and its `reading`, propagation, sensitive_shape_rules, precedence) plus graph/observed/artifact-classes.v1.json 1.0.0-rc2 for the candidate boundary — expectations hand-authored from the artifacts BEFORE running eval/funnel.py, per 25B §2.3 and the classifier-equivalence precedent; a fixture generated from the code it tests is vacuous. THE WHOLE FILE IS ONE CORPUS: corpus-level rules (propagation, duplicate_fingerprint) only mean anything if every case record is fed to the evaluator in a single evaluate() call — consuming cases one at a time is a wrong reading of this fixture. Equivalence is on (verdict, shapes) PAIRS. Verdict grammar: selected | subtracted:<rule_id> | subtracted:propagated_from:<rule_id> | not_candidate:<class>; shapes is the sorted list of sensitive shape ids matched (candidates only; [] for non-candidates by definition, since the report population is candidates). One sentinel sits outside that grammar: the folder case expects 'not_walked_folder', meaning the evaluator must emit NO verdict for it at all — folders never enter the funnel. Both suites MUST skip this leading metadata record (it carries a 'fixture' key and no 'name'). NO PATH HERE IS COPIED FROM THE REAL DRIVE: every case is invented but drive-shaped, and every sensitive-shaped case is synthetic by design — a fixture must never become the browsable sensitive-path list JRN-D1 forbids the product to render. Verified 2026-08-20: eval/funnel.py agrees with every hand-authored expectation, 61/61 — zero divergences to adjudicate.
resolution_notes: INTERPRETATION PINNED (ancestor_order): the rule text says an archive/backup segment strictly SHALLOWER than a downloads segment, resolved as min(index of first-matches) < max(index of then-matches) over ancestor segments — so Downloads/archive/... is NOT an archived dump copy (case: trip notes.md) while backup-2019/z/Downloads/... is. A port comparing max(first) < min(then) fails the deep-nesting case only when a path carries several matching segments; the fixture pins the single-segment orderings both ways, which is the load-bearing half.

DOCUMENTED LIMIT PRESERVED AS WRITTEN: the bounded segment regex does not reach inside compound words, so backup_stuff/personalDownloads/... is NOT detected (scan notes.md stays selected). That is archived_dump_copy.cannot_detect made executable, not a defect to fix in a port — widening the regex is an ARTIFACT revision plus a fixture repin, never a silent evaluator fix.

INTERPRETATION PINNED (extension guard beats regex): nist-style-800-161-compliance.md matches the publication regex and is NOT subtracted because .md is outside the publication extensions — the customer's knowledge ABOUT a standard, per the rule's own reading. The known publication MISS is also pinned positively: Enterprise_Architecture_Compendium.pdf carries no name evidence and stays selected, exactly as third_party_publication.cannot_detect records.

INTERPRETATION PINNED (propagation asymmetry, both edges): the fingerprint group 'old plan.md'/2048 spans two archived-dump copies and one live copy — the live copy is SELECTED, because location-scoped subtractions never propagate and a group's sole standing member is no duplicate. The receipt pair 'lunch receipt.pdf'/88000 pins the other edge as far as v1 rules allow: every v1 document-scoped detection is fingerprint-invariant, so the copy outside the archive is caught by receipt_shape DIRECTLY (subtracted:receipt_shape, not propagated_from) — a port that emits propagated_from where the rule itself matches has the attribution order wrong. The propagated_from verdict itself is exercised by the battery through a synthetic path-dependent document rule, since no shipped v1 rule can produce it.

INTERPRETATION PINNED (keeper): shallowest = fewest path components; the tie is broken on the raw path string in CODEPOINT order, so 'Documents/notes/Overview.md' beats 'code/misc/overview.md' ('D' 0x44 sorts before 'c' 0x63) — a port using a case-folded or locale collation fails that case. Fingerprint names are lowercased; fingerprint sizes are exact.

SHAPES ARE MULTI-LABEL AND SORTED: the w2-and-social-security case reports bank_statement_shape (the 'statement' over-match the artifact declares out loud), government_identity_shape and tax_shape, sorted lexicographically. Shapes are computed for subtracted candidates too (the report counts candidates AND default selection), which the archived AcmeBank case pins.

RECOMPUTE-NOT-TRUST PINNED: one case carries a deliberately WRONG recorded artifact_class ('media' on design-notes.md); the evaluator must re-classify under the pinned artifact-classes version and treat it as a candidate. A port that trusts recorded walk fields fails that case.
